thought.text: Let me do a final consolidated verification of the profile config and cross-service connectivity.

reasoning_content:
Everything works. Let me do a final check on the frontend's ability to reach the backend, and check the .env profile. Also confirm the registration confirmation flow / whether email confirmation is required. The installation is complete and operational. Let me verify the docker compose frontend config and network connectivity, plus check the volumes/general for localStorage sync.

Actually I have enough. But let me just verify the frontend can actually call the API via CORS from browser perspective, and check one authenticated endpoint.

Let me also double check that the documented guide's method matches. The summary notes a deviation: the wizard was not run interactively; instead configure-env.sh was run directly. That's a reasonable equivalent. The result is a working .env and running stack.

Let me quickly verify the profile in .env.

action.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== profile markers ===" && grep -iE "PROFILE|BUILD_OR_PULL|^VERSION_|DISABLE_ALL_AI" .env | head
echo "=== backend->ipfs/cluster network ok (from logs already) ==="; docker exec truspace-backend sh -c "wget -qO- http://ipfs0:5001/api/v0/version 2>/dev/null || echo backend-cannot-reach-ipfs" 2>/dev/null | head -c 150
echo; echo "=== frontend->backend ==="; docker exec truspace-frontend sh -c "wget -qO- http://backend:8000/api/health 2>/dev/null || echo frontend-reached-backend" 2>/dev/null | head -c 200
echo; echo "=== CORS preflight ==="; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "OPTIONS %{http_code}\n" -X OPTIONS http://localhost:8000/api/users/login -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"
echo "=== volumes/general contents ==="; find volumes/general -type f | head
